title: Quick Chinese Pepper Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese-inspired pilaf dish made with quick-cooking ingredients.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the red and green peppers and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the rice pilaf mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Optional: Add cooked chicken or shrimp to make it a complete meal.
